# unbound Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "unbound" {
  host = "https://plbnet-dns-eu01.adm.platylab.com:8091"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) URI for Unbound API. May also be provided via UNBOUND_HOST environment variable.
